# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** micro — the Engine E2E planner's duration table, refreshed from hosted runs; no logic changes.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** My approval at `9623535612` covered one row. The head moved to `721c06bd33`, a refresh of the whole table, so this is a fresh read of the new head. The delta: 22 rows added, none removed, 63 changed, and the table's total plan goes from 4,439 s to 5,064 s; `ExamplesCatalogTheme` keeps its 67.7 s. Each added row is a spec the planner was budgeting at the 32.6 s fallback, and several cost far more: `timeline/PlanningThemeSwitcher` 69.7 s, `board/BigData` 59.6 s, `portal/StandaloneExamplesThemeSwitcher` 43.6 s. Those are more under-planned shards of the kind the first row fixed, and the reason one corrected row only moved the overflow to shard 1. Spot-checked against dev's run 45043370399 (`5a338859ee`): `PlanningThemeSwitcher` ran 32 tests in 67.3 s of test time, consistent with 69.7. The keep-the-higher rule plans conservatively, which `durationOf`'s own rationale calls the safe direction: a shard planned too high runs light, and the excess spreads thinly over the others. At this head all 15 `e2e-engine` shards passed. What I looked for and did not find: a removed row, which would drop a file back to the fallback.

**Findings:** None blocking.
